product_metadata.title: Ottomanson Luxury Collection Blue Runner Rug with Non-Slip/Rubber-Backing Bath Rug, 2'2" X 6'0", Turquoise
features: Low Pile: The pile height on these stair treads will bring exquisite charm into your home and will prevent catching and curling under doors or feet
Durable, Long Lasting, and Shed-Free: Made in Turkey and machine-woven with 100% polypropylene prevents shed and ensures a lengthy lifetime even in high traffic areas of the home
Non-Slip Rubber Backing: the rubber backing of our treads provide traction and prevents slippage for both you and your pets
Practical: protects your floors from scratches, wear-and-tear, and reduces noise
Use Everywhere with Easy care: This will look great in your kitchen, bath, on your bedside, etc. and all you'll need to do should you it is spot-clean with mild soap or detergent
description: As a brilliant addition of casual sophistication to your space, The Luxury Collection offers elegant rugs in rich solid colors. Featuring a soft texture combined with an updated solid design, this contemporary rug creates a cozy look and enhances the appearance of your room while smoothly blending with most home decor. The softness on your feet can be a great escape from hard-floors while the firm construction of the pile provides floor-protection and a noise dampening effect. This rug is also shed-resistant offering easy upkeep, fast drying and carefree maintenance, which makes it a suitable completion to any room including spill-prone and heavy traffic areas like your kitchen, bathroom, by your vanity sink, hallways, dining rooms, bed rooms, living rooms, foyer and homes with pets. Overall, the high quality construction of the pile and non-slip rubber backing makes this rug so durable that it is guaranteed to offer years of comfort withstanding everyday foot traffic. Make your home complete by decorating your floors with one exquisite Luxury rug available in a rich variety of colors and sizes and enjoy our newest addition that brilliantly combines functional pile height with utilitarian and practical rubber backing.
